name: Chimichagua (Colombia)
description: Divided diagonally from the upper hoist to the lower fly, blue above and red below, charged at the centre with a white disc bearing the motto PAZ UNION Y TRABAJO in black.
history: Municipal flag of Chimichagua, a municipality in the department of Cesar, Colombia; Colombian municipal flags are adopted by agreement (acuerdo) of the municipal council or by decree of the mayor.

features.role: motto PAZ UNION Y TRABAJO on the disc
